frozen_theorems_and_algorithms: Deterministic sufficiency on finite adjudication support is equivalent to an empty heterogeneous Z-fiber collision graph.
A subset of prospectively admissible hidden observables repairs finite-support sufficiency iff it separates every collision edge.
Minimum-cardinality prospective rescue is a minimum set-cover problem over collision edges and is NP-hard in general.
A coordinate is deletion-necessary on tested support only if removing it from an otherwise sufficient basis reintroduces at least one collision edge.
Static quotient fiber equivalence is weaker than dynamic quotient equivalence under intervention-response commutation.
